description: Admin CMS UI - Build the admin panel pages for managing page content: /admin/content (list view) and /admin/content/[slug] (edit view with page-specific form). Add 'Page Content' link to admin sidebar. Follow existing admin page patterns from app/admin/(dashboard)/settings/advanced/page.tsx for layout and styling
steps: Add { name: 'Page Content', href: '/admin/content', icon: Layout } to the menuItems array in app/admin/(dashboard)/admin-sidebar.tsx under the 'Content' section (import Layout from lucide-react)
Create app/admin/(dashboard)/content/page.tsx as a server component with `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` and `export const revalidate = 0`

In /admin/content/page.tsx: call getAllPagesMetadata() from content-helpers, render a grid of 7 cards (one per page: home, about, services, contact, projects, team, careers) showing page name, last updated timestamp, number of fields, and an Edit button linking to /admin/content/[slug]
Style the cards using existing patterns: bg-card border border-border rounded-2xl, consistent with app/admin/(dashboard)/settings/advanced/page.tsx

Create app/admin/(dashboard)/content/[slug]/page.tsx as a server component that: extracts slug from params, validates slug is one of the 7 allowed pages (home|about|services|contact|projects|team|careers), fetches current content via getPageContentForEdit(slug), passes content to a client component edit form, shows 404-like message if slug is invalid

Create app/admin/(dashboard)/content/[slug]/content-edit-form.tsx as a 'use client' component that: receives slug and current content as props, renders page-specific form fields based on slug (use switch statement or object lookup), shows inline success/error messages after save (use useState for messages), calls savePageContent() server action on form submit, uses react-hook-form if available in package.json (it is: see react-hook-form@^7.60.0), includes SEO fields (meta_title, meta_description, meta_keywords) at bottom of every form

Implement form field configurations for each page following the task requirements: home (hero section: title, subtitle, 2 CTAs; about section: title, description; CTA section: title, description, button text), about (hero: title, subtitle; story: title, body; stats: founded, team_size, projects; mission/vision/values text), services (hero: title, subtitle), contact (contact info: phone, email, address, hours), projects (hero: title, subtitle; section titles), team (hero: title, subtitle; management_title, developers_title), careers (hero: title, subtitle; benefits list; culture description)
acceptance_criteria: Admin sidebar includes 'Page Content' menu item with Layout icon in the Content section
/admin/content page displays a grid of 7 page cards with name, last updated, edit button
/admin/content/[slug] page validates the slug and shows appropriate error for invalid slugs
content-edit-form.tsx renders page-specific form fields based on the slug prop
Form successfully saves changes via savePageContent() and shows success/error feedback inline
All forms include SEO meta fields at the bottom (meta_title, meta_description, meta_keywords)
UI styling is consistent with existing admin pages (dark cards, rounded-2xl borders, bg-card)
verification: Navigate to /admin/content in browser and verify 7 page cards are displayed
Click Edit on the 'home' card, verify form loads with current content values
Change the hero_title field, click Save, verify success message appears inline
Navigate to the public homepage (/) and verify the hero title has updated
Test editing at least 2 other pages (about, services) to confirm page-specific forms work
Check browser console for any TypeScript or runtime errors
findings: Successfully implemented Admin CMS UI. Added 'Page Content' menu item with Layout icon to admin sidebar under Content section. Created /admin/content listing page with 7 page cards (home, about, services, contact, projects, team, careers) displaying page name, last updated timestamp, content fields count, and Edit button. Implemented /admin/content/[slug] edit page with slug validation and 404 handling for invalid slugs. Created content-edit-form.tsx client component with react-hook-form integration, page-specific forms using switch-based field rendering (home: hero/stats/about/cta sections; about: hero/mission/vision/values; services: hero/cta; contact: hero/form/info; projects: hero/filters; team: hero/management/development; careers: hero/positions/no-positions), inline success/error messages with auto-dismiss, and SEO fields (meta_title, meta_description, meta_keywords) at bottom of all forms. All pages use export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic' and export const revalidate = 0. UI styling follows existing patterns with bg-card, border-border, rounded-2xl. PowerShell execution policy prevented running build verification, but code structure, imports, and patterns manually verified against existing codebase.
